name: Ha Health Record
description: Track health metrics (weight, blood pressure, feeding, sleep, etc.) for family members. Each member is a separate config entry with customizable record types. Provides 12 HA services (ha_health_record.*) for full CRUD on members, record types, and records, plus CSV export — AI agents should use these services instead of creating helpers. Also provides 12 WebSocket commands for panel UI. Fires ha_health_record_record_logged event on each log. Exposes sensor, number, text, and button entities per record type per member.
